state_authority: existing TrainingRepository SQLite database and DatasetRegistry source admission
output: TrainingObservationReport.as_dict() exposes JSON-safe identities, bounded committed checkpoint/telemetry series, real checkpoint loss, budget usage, lease activity and explicit availability; digest binds the selected committed evidence and injected observation time
read_only: Dataset lock then training repository lock, matching trainer publication order. One existing repository read transaction provides a consistent committed snapshot; no SGD, generated model outputs, schema creation, checkpoints, recovery, retention or telemetry writes. Preference restore can recompute bounded log likelihood to validate already committed DPO observations.
semantic_validation: Manifest and binding digests, checkpoint cursor/model/optimizer/seed/usage/terminal invariants use the corresponding existing trainer restore validator with exact admitted materialized corpus; old digest-only compatibility checkpoints expose metadata with unavailable model progress

measurements.loss: Initial/final byte corpus cross entropy already persisted by canonical neural/parallel/elastic trainers; DPO logistic preference loss and chosen-vs-rejected log-likelihood margin are separately named and recomputed by the canonical preference restore validator. Reference loss and per-update loss are unavailable; legacy corpora without bytes do not publish caller-declared usage or loss as verified evidence.
measurements.numerical_health: actual committed model payload parsing rejects nonfinite or malformed learned parameters; observed finite loss is checked, no future convergence or model quality claim
measurements.throughput: unavailable until a canonical writer persists actual measured elapsed intervals; injected run/checkpoint timestamps are never used to invent elapsed training time or throughput
measurements.telemetry: Recorded events bind exact digest/run/step/timestamp. Known counters associated with selected, semantically verified checkpoints must agree; unknown metrics and counters outside selected checkpoint evidence remain explicitly unverified. Telemetry has no durable worker epoch, so none is invented.

timeline: UTC timestamps cannot precede run registration, regress through selected committed checkpoint/event order (including one immediate window predecessor) or lie after injected observation time. Events cannot reference future steps; missing old live checkpoint association is permitted only when the run has archive receipts and is explicitly unverified rather than claimed restored or archived evidence.
leases: existing WorkerLease stores epoch and issue time, not expiry/heartbeat. Reports distinguish current/stale epoch and activity age; stall alerts are operational suspicions, never proof a worker died or an automatic recovery grant
recovery: existing recovering/failed states, worker epoch changes and latest checkpoint epoch identify recovery windows; exact recovery transition timestamps/counts remain unavailable when not durably recorded

alerts.training_stalled: runbook:training-observability/training_stalled: inspect current worker/process, last durable cursor and dataset admission before explicitly requesting governed recovery
alerts.worker_epoch_stale: runbook:training-observability/worker_epoch_stale: withdraw the obsolete worker; never accept stale writes
alerts.recovery_pending: runbook:training-observability/recovery_pending: resume only through existing fenced trainer and checkpoint authority
alerts.training_failed: runbook:training-observability/training_failed: inspect failure evidence and immutable configuration before retry
alerts.loss_increased: runbook:training-observability/loss_increased: evaluate held-out quality and optimization configuration; loss change alone grants no promotion or rollback

retention: Reports declare total committed live checkpoint/event counts and selected recent windows. Retained archive gaps expose unavailable_missing_live_checkpoint with no verified counters; the observer neither reads CAS archives nor claims full pruned history.
failure: TrainingObservationError on source/config/manifest/checkpoint/model/timeline/telemetry/budget tamper or resource bounds; no authoritative state changes on rejection

verification.focused_observation_and_lock_order: 38 passed in independent final combined suite

semantic_compute_limit: Validation work scales with the bounded selected checkpoint count and each existing trainer corpus/model ceiling. Preference restore recomputes the complete bounded pair objective for each selected checkpoint while dataset and run locks are held. Read-only does not imply inexpensive or a latency guarantee; operators can reduce max_points for large histories. This API measures no validation wall time and does not invent a throughput result.
